title: Spectra Ultra S/TEM
supported_facts: The official description combines a wide-gap objective with an analytical double-tilt holder; the holder obscures part of the EDS collection solid angle.
unsupported_claims: No engineering dimensions for the holder envelope are provided; side-entry dimensions cannot be inferred from EDS performance values.
